description: This file is a shell script containing tests for git checkout paths, including setup, checkout behavior, and file state validations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs associated commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal test clock to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is an existing file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing/not present.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Expects the following command to fail.

methods.name: test-tool chmtime
methods.description: Checks or modifies the file modification time.
